text:
Tyler Toffoli is on his seventh NHL team and still does what he has always done: he scores. Six goals and 14 points in 25 games, seven on the power play, in 13 minutes a night, and his goals line up with his chances. San Jose is almost six points better on five-on-five expected goals with him on than without (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and he ranks in the top 70 in the league in wins added by goals this season.

He is 34, with 309 career goals and a Stanley Cup with the Kings in 2014, and he runs the second power-play unit on a young team. He also still hates missing. Max Miller of Sharks Hockey Digest saw him snap his stick on the bench after a missed breakaway. Our range has him around 19 goals, which would be about normal for him.
